releases.name: Monster Showdown
releases.summary: You play as a Reaper who was sent out to hunt down monsters who have invaded the land. Visit haunted locations filled with all sorts of strange beings. No run will be the same due to procedurally generated levels and a multitude of ability upgrades.

releases.name: EXORCISMUS: Vade Retro Satana
releases.summary: A psychological exorcism horror featuring the unique Presence System and a 3D Jumpscare effect that makes demons burst out of your screen. Every sound has a source. The demon sees you, hears you, senses your fear. Forget predictable jumpscares.

releases.name: Kings of Oros
releases.summary: In Oros, battles are real physical interactions, not static animations. Swings carry momentum, collisions have weight. Find synergies in weapons, relics, cards, enchantments, classes and more to unleash crazy builds and try to break the game as you battle armies, bosses, and other players in PVP.

releases.name: DeathSlots
releases.summary: The Rules are Simple: You must reach 1,000,000 Gold --- If you run out of gold you die!! ????

releases.name: Starship Crafter
releases.summary:
Take on the starship mechanic role and pay the immense debt your father left you with. 

Upgrade your workshop, craft components, build starships, do contracts for factions, follow the ongoing events with the daily newspaper, and most importantly, pay the debt before the deadline.

releases.name: Lost Camp
releases.summary: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.

releases.name: The House on Grisewood
releases.summary: A top-down survival horror shooter set in a haunted manor. Explore room by room with a failing flashlight, scavenge ammunition and batteries, and fight or evade what stalks the dark. Reach the ballroom and end what laughs there, or hold out in an endless Zombie Survival mode.

releases.name: The Endless Harvest
releases.summary: Ever been to Thailand? Bangkok Betty is a new twist on an old Beer Pong favourite. Help Betty to launch her Ping Pong Balls off of the obstacles and into the Pint Glass, and remember to collect as many coins as you can while you're at it.Bangkok Betty is a fun physics and puzzle game with great re-playability.Stay tuned for more worlds in free app updates, coming very soon!

releases.name: Meow Star Archives
releases.summary: In this 2D puzzle game, you need to restore the cats’ severely damaged memory archives to stop their souls from fading away. As you restore the archives, you’ll uncover the heartfelt stories of these lovely kitties before they journey back to the stars.

releases.name: Mapping Creator
releases.summary: Draw maps, make nations fight and create historical or fantasy timelapses with Mapping Creator: a tool to unleash creativity!

releases.name: Story of The Needle In a Haystack
releases.summary: They say finding a needle in a haystack is impossible. Time to prove them wrong. Clear millions of pieces of hay from an old barn, upgrade your tools, sell what you collect, and search every last pile until that tiny needle finally shows itself.

releases.name: Sorcerous 2 City of Cults
releases.summary: Introducing "Word Puzzle for the Mother's Soul", This is a beautiful inspirational motherly quotes inspired Word Game.• 87 inspirational levels• Intuitive Controls• Animated Tutorial• Hours of Inspiration Challenging Fun Game Play!• Internalize/Absorb quotes better by challenged enigmatic Game Play!.On the game board, you are given a quote by great men and women. The tiles are shuffled and not readable. Your task is to put the tiles back into their places and recover the original quote.To reconstruct a quote, you must swap the letter tiles until you get every correct words. The tiles can only be swapped vertically in its respective column.Once the original quote is revealed you level up!. Be inspired by these great quotes from great minds.

releases.name: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive!
releases.summary: Bring order to a perfume archive of 3,240 bottles, solo or with a friend, in this relaxing first-person organizing game. Read labels, place bottles on the right shelves, develop helpful skills, and watch completed collections light up the archive.

releases.name: Tidy Mall Together
releases.summary: A cosy co-op tidying game. Sort + 4,600 runaway things back onto the shelves of 11 shops with up to 3 friends. Grab, stack and shelve, unlock magnets, scanners and sorting robots, hunt 25 golden items, play mini games and turn the messiest mall in town into the tidiest.

releases.name: How Smart Are You
releases.summary: The year is 3518. On a faraway planet you find a pyramid built by someone very clever, and nobody is there. Inside, 30 puzzle rooms test your IQ. Every room hides one right door, every mistake costs you points, and six pictures on the walls slowly tell you what happened here.

releases.name: Embodybird
releases.summary: Embodybird is a small, physics-based game with continuous bird flight controls. Decide how hard to flap, how far to spread your wings—even how wide to fan your feathers! Fly, land, hunt, and carry your catch home before dark. EMBODY THE BIRD!

releases.name: Construction Site: Tidy Up Together
releases.summary: The delivery truck just tipped a whole building into one giant heap. Dig out bricks, logs, steel beams and Sash Windows, check the plan and fit every part into its glowing blueprint slot. Then bin the rubbish, return the tools and watch the lights come on, solo or with your crew.

releases.name: 2D Hates 3D
releases.summary: A short incremental game where you play as Commander, leading a squad of flat 2D shapes against an invasion of 3D ones. Clear timed waves, collect scrap. Upgrade 200+ skills in a skill tree, from squad damage to time-bending perks. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.

releases.name: Island Sort
releases.summary: Pirates trashed the island! Grab thousands of scattered goods and sort them into the right crates and shelves, solo or in 3-player co-op. Unlock portal doors, uncover secrets and race a friend in 1v1 sorting duels.

releases.name: Crash Protocol: The Wrong Directive
releases.summary: Outsmart malfunctioning robots in a turn-based grid strategy game. Lure them into collisions, use tactical bonuses and Safe Teleport, and master 50 fixed campaign levels, endless Survival waves and a separate ASCII Classic mode.

releases.name: Necromancer: Revival of the Dead
releases.summary: Raise the fallen and build your own legion of the dead. Command the kings you defeat as elite summons, swap between 8 shot types and unleash screen-filling skills in this dark fantasy survival action game.

releases.name: Komorebi Alchemy
releases.summary: Gather materials, practice alchemy, and grow a little shop with your companions in this shopkeeping RPG. Enjoy puzzle-based crafting, workshop decorating, a café, farming, and town development as you prepare for raids. Your creations can help protect the town.

releases.name: Restaurant Rush Together
releases.summary: Run a Brazilian pastel shop in first person: roll the dough, fill, fry and serve every pastel with your own hands. Hire staff, build your shop your way and grow from one kitchen to outer space, solo or with up to 10 friends online.

releases.name: Tinsel Tumble
releases.summary: A cozy Holiday falling-block puzzle game. Drop pairs of elves and presents into the well, land an elf beside presents of its color to wrap the lot, and set off chain reactions. Story, Endless, 50 Challenges, Daily, an Advent calendar, and couch Versus and Battle mode for up to 4 players.

releases.name: Escape Your Boss
releases.summary: An overworked accountant in a ninja suit takes on his entire company. Fight your way out of Megacorp Tower in a pixel-art action platformer, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

releases.name: Wrapuzzle
releases.summary: An original game of patience and relaxation where the jigsaw puzzles only have two edges! Reassemble them and wrap them around objects of your choice to display on your shelves. Human-made unique designs. Choose between 100 and 2,000 pieces, and have fun!

releases.name: Winky!: Find the Golden Ticket
releases.summary: 1 Billion chocolate bars! One golden ticket is hidden in a mountain of Winky chocolate bars. Open them, rewrap the chocolate as your own knock-off brand, Wonko!, and sell it. Hire staff, build production lines and grow a factory big enough to find the ticket, alone or with up to three friends.

releases.name: The Eggsortist
releases.summary: A chicken possessed by the Devil has laid 4,266 colored eggs in a barn, but 666 of them are demonic eggs in disguise! Sort the eggs, find the evil impostors, and burn them before they hatch and doom the world.

releases.name: KINETET
releases.summary: A falling-block puzzle driven by physics. Adjust your angle and power to launch blocks that roll, tumble, and stack. Connect same-colored blocks from wall to wall to clear them, and compete with players worldwide for the high score on the online leaderboards!

releases.name: Taskbar Fishing & Aquarium
releases.summary: An idle fishing and aquarium game for the corner of your desktop. While you work, a small window quietly fishes for you. Collect 35 species across 10 rarity tiers, then decorate your tank with castles, rocks and coral to build the aquarium you want.

releases.name: Metal Simulator
releases.summary: Start as a solo metal musician in 1970 and build the greatest metal band of all time! Write songs, release albums, recruit musicians, tour, grow your fanbase, and evolve with the changing sounds of metal across the decades.

releases.name: Shellcrushers
releases.summary: Shellcrushers is a stylized horde tower defense game: tens of thousands of roaches pour in at once, and you meet them with six turrets, RPG-deep upgrade trees and procedurally generated maps, so no two fights play the same.

releases.name: Blubbis Abenteuer
releases.summary: German-language interactive children’s book with full German voice narration – no English version available

releases.name: Tanks & Trebuchets
releases.summary: A WW2 tank in a medieval world, fighting armies of several hundred soldiers at a time and knocking down their castles. There is an open-world campaign, a Gauntlet roguelike mode, and online co-op and PvP with friends for up to four players.

releases.name: Paint the Town
releases.summary: One morning, every color in town is gone. Grab a brush and bring it back: paint houses, cars, trees and towers until the gray city glows again. A calm, satisfying first-person incremental game — from a single brush to a paint cannon. Almost half a million square meters are waiting.

releases.name: Forts of Canada
releases.summary: Forts of Canada is a single-player 2D strategy game about keeping eight historic Canadian forts standing. Manage supplies, recruit troops, fire the cannons, sail dangerous waters and plan battles before watching them unfold.

releases.name: Yule Dads
releases.summary: Yule Dads is a chaotic multiplayer Christmas party game. Gather your friends and trick, grind, and race through the mall to win the last presents before closing time.

releases.name: Dragon Egg Survivor
releases.summary: Survive waves of monsters as a princess knight in this top-down action roguelite. Your attacks are automatic, so focus on dodging and choosing upgrades. Protect dragon eggs until they hatch, then fight alongside your new dragon allies to defeat powerful bosses.
